label: Surabaya
short_description: Split between the central Tunjungan business district and the West Surabaya Pakuwon mall corridor.
intro: Surabaya, Indonesia's second-largest city and East Java's commercial capital, splits into two hotel clusters: the central business district around Tunjungan and Embong Malang, home to the established flagship hotels near Tunjungan Plaza; and the newer West Surabaya growth corridor around the Pakuwon malls, where several recent hotels connect directly to shopping and entertainment. Coverage here is business- and mall-oriented rather than leisure, reached via Juanda International Airport (SUB) southeast of the city.
